latestVersion.changelog:
Product Hunt Launch Coach v1.0.0 – Launch guidance built for the 2024–2026 Product Hunt reality.

- Provides an end-to-end playbook: pre-launch prep, launch day operations, and post-launch follow-up, tailored for the current Product Hunt algorithm.
- Emphasizes: comment quality, pre-/post-launch activities, realistic outcomes, and discourages outdated/abusive tactics (vote rings, paid hunters, AI-generated listings).
- Diagnostic sweep ensures product, category, and maker readiness before recommending any launch action.
- Details specific triggers and exclusions so the coach activates only for genuine Product Hunt launch discussions.
- Includes updated strategic guidance for B2B, AI, indie, dev, and consumer products.
- Prepares makers for post-launch conversion and traffic recovery, not just badge chasing or vanity launches.
